import numpy as np

def line_pose(start, end, step_m=0.006):
    """Dense straight-line EE targets to keep each 20 Hz step under speed limit."""
    start, end = np.asarray(start, float), np.asarray(end, float)
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - start[:3]) / step_m)))
    f = np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float)[:, None] / n
    return np.concatenate([start[None, :] * (1-f) + end[None, :] * f], axis=1)
